title: Mission Control development
description: This repository: uv with the biotech and dbcontract groups, make, and Docker Compose for the services (application PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector, Redis, Temporal 1.31 with its admin-tools CLI image); PostgreSQL and Temporal run as those pinned images, not as host toolchains. Its base layer is the Mission Control-owned .cursor/environment.json, Dockerfile and scripts (DECISIONS R24).
